why: A market that says its own scale (fm-server#1059). Read without priceDecimals and unitDecimals, every SDK assumes cents and whole units and shows 1.2345 as $123.45. priceDecimals is 0 on purpose: a parser that defaults on a falsey value rather than an absent one reads it as 2.

source.constructed: fm-server does not send priceDecimals or unitDecimals yet (fm-server#1060); this is the shape docs/PRICE-SCALE.md section 3.1 gives them, with values that differ from both defaults.

payload.name: Grain
payload.description: whole dollars, thousandths of a tonne
